assertion: USDA raised its 2026 net farm income forecast to $158.4 billion.
warehouse_value: $158.354 billion (158,353,790 thousand) for US, 2026, category=Net income/subcategory=Farm income
sql: SELECT "year", amount FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND category='Net income' AND subcategory='Farm income' AND "year"=2026

sources.title: USDA ERS Farm Income and Wealth Statistics

assertion: The September 2026 forecast is $5 billion higher than USDA's February 2026 forecast.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT publication_date FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND "year"=2026
reason: This corpus's ag.ers_farm_income table carries only the latest ERS release for 2026 (publication_date = 'Data as of September 3, 2026'); no February 2026 vintage of the same series is retained, so the $5B revision cannot be independently confirmed or refuted from this data.

sources.title: USDA ERS Farm Income Forecast (February 2026 release, archived)

assertion: 2026 net farm income represents a 2.6% nominal decline from 2025.
sql: SELECT "year", amount FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND category='Net income' AND subcategory='Farm income' AND "year" IN (2025,2026)

assertion: After adjusting for inflation, 2026 net farm income represents a 5.5% real decline from 2025.
warehouse_value: Using the table's own gdp_deflator column (2026=100.0, 2025=97.089): 2025 amount restated in 2026 dollars = 162,614.96/0.97089 = $167,490M; decline to $158,354M = -5.46% (~5.5%)
sql: SELECT "year", amount, gdp_deflator FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND category='Net income' AND subcategory='Farm income' AND "year" IN (2025,2026)

assertion: Federal government farm program payments are expected to rise about 70% in 2026.
sql: SELECT "year", amount FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND category='Government payments' AND subcategory='Total' AND "year" IN (2025,2026)

assertion: Production costs are expected to rise 4.5% to $492.8 billion in 2026.
warehouse_value: 2025: $471.570B, 2026: $492.813B -> +4.50% (ERS 'total production expenses including imputed items' series, artificial_key EXAUSPE--INP)
sql: SELECT "year", amount, artificial_key FROM ag.ers_farm_income WHERE state='US' AND category='Production expenses' AND subcategory='All' AND "year" IN (2025,2026)
